recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Bring water to a boil, add tea leaves and steep for 2–3 minutes. 2. (4 min) Strain and sweeten if desired.

recipes.name: Strong Black Tea
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil water, add tea leaves and steep a little longer for a stronger brew. 2. (4 min) Strain and serve.

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Pour freshly boiled water over Assam tea leaves, steep for 3–4 minutes, then strain.

ingredients.original: 2 tsp green tea leaves or tea bag

recipes.name: Kashmiri Kahwa
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer spices in water, switch off the heat, add green tea and steep briefly. 2. (5 min) Strain and garnish with sliced almonds and saffron.

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Brew coffee with a little hot water. 2. (5 min) Heat milk, combine with the coffee and add sugar to taste.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.

recipes.name: Garlic Rice
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Sauté sliced garlic in oil or ghee until fragrant. 2. (13 min) Add cooked rice, salt and pepper, and toss until heated through.
recipes.notes: Uses already-cooked rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup cooked rice, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 2 tsp oil or ghee, ¼ tsp pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Pepper Rice
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Crush pepper and cumin coarsely. 2. (13 min) Fry with curry leaves in ghee, add cooked rice and salt, and mix well.
recipes.notes: Uses already-cooked rice. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup cooked rice, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 2 tsp ghee, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Cumin Potato Curry
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cube potatoes and cook with cumin and spices. 2. (12 min) Add a splash of water, cover and simmer until tender.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium peeled and diced potatoes, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt, ½ cup water

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Curry
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté onion, ginger and cumin. 2. (12 min) Add tomatoes and spices, cook until soft, and simmer with a little water to make a simple curry.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium chopped tomatoes, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp coriander powder, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Plain Sambar

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — sambar powder
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — sambar powder

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables

recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Cook dal until soft. 2. (16 min) Simmer vegetables with tamarind and sambar powder, add dal and cook together until flavors combine.
recipes.notes: Uses prepared sambar powder. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: ½ cup (dry) toor dal, to taste / as needed — tamarind, to taste / as needed — sambar powder, to taste / as needed — mixed vegetables, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Plain Rasam

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — rasam powder
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — rasam powder

recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Simmer tomato with tamarind water and rasam powder. 2. (12 min) Add a tempering of mustard, cumin and curry leaves; avoid boiling for too long.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ cup tamarind water, to taste / as needed — rasam powder, ¼ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp mustard seeds, 2 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Plain Ragi Porridge
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix ragi flour with a little cool water to prevent lumps. 2. (5 min) Stir into simmering water or milk and cook until thick, then season.
recipes.notes: Can be sweet or savory. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup ragi flour, ½ cup water or milk, ¼ tsp salt or jaggery

recipes.name: Lassi

ingredients.original: ½ cup chilled water or milk

recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk or blend curd with chilled water or milk until smooth. 2. (2 min) Add sugar for sweet lassi or salt and roasted cumin for savory lassi.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: ½ cup curd, ½ cup chilled water or milk, ¼ tsp sugar or salt

recipes.name: Salted Buttermilk
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Whisk curd with water until thin. 2. (2 min) Mix in salt and roasted cumin, then garnish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: ½ cup curd, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ tsp roasted cumin, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

recipes.name: Plain Milk
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Heat milk in a clean saucepan, stirring occasionally, until steaming or gently simmering. 2. (5 min) Serve warm or chilled.
recipes.notes: Basic beverage. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup milk

recipes.name: Warm Turmeric Milk
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Warm milk with turmeric and optional pepper, stirring well. 2. (5 min) Sweeten to taste and serve warm.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup milk, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp black pepper (optional), 1–2 tsp jaggery or sugar (optional)

recipes.name: Plain Suji Halwa
recipes.preparation: 1. (16 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Roast semolina in ghee until fragrant. 2. (16 min) Carefully add hot water, stir until thick, then add sugar and cardamom and cook until glossy.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup semolina, 2 tsp ghee, 1–2 tsp sugar, ½ cup water, ¼ tsp cardamom, to taste / as needed — nuts (optional)

recipes.name: Steamed Sweet Corn
recipes.preparation: 1. (11 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Boil or steam corn until tender. 2. (11 min) Drain and season with salt, pepper and lemon juice.
recipes.notes: Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: ½ cup sweet corn, 1½ cups water, ¼ tsp salt, ½ lemon juice, ¼ tsp pepper

recipes.name: Roasted Papad
recipes.preparation: 1. (25 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Roast papad over a flame or on a dry pan, turning frequently, until crisp.
recipes.notes: No oil needed. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: to taste / as needed — papad

recipes.name: Plain Dal Rice
recipes.preparation: 1. (13 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Serve warm cooked rice with simple cooked dal. 2. (13 min) Add a little ghee if desired.
recipes.notes: Basic everyday meal assembled from cooked components. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup cooked rice, ½ cup (dry) cooked dal, 2 tsp ghee (optional), ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Bombay Vegetable Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — green chutney
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — green chutney

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Spread green chutney on bread. 2. (4 min) Layer sliced potato, cucumber, tomato and onion. 3. (4 min) Sprinkle chaat masala and salt, cover with another slice and cut into triangles. 4. (4 min) Toast in butter if desired.
recipes.notes: Classic Mumbai-style vegetable sandwich; serve with chutney. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp boiled potato, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, to taste / as needed — green chutney, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp chaat masala, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Grilled Vegetable Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — green chutney
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — green chutney

recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Spread chutney on bread and arrange thinly sliced vegetables. 2. (7 min) Season with pepper and salt, close the sandwich and grill until crisp and golden.
recipes.notes: Use any seasonal vegetables. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, 2 tsp butter, to taste / as needed — green chutney, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Plain Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Place cheese between two buttered bread slices. 2. (7 min) Toast in a pan or sandwich press until the bread is golden and the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Quick basic cheese sandwich. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese slices, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp black pepper

recipes.name: Cucumber Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Spread a thin layer of butter or mayonnaise on bread. 2. (2 min) Add thin cucumber slices, season lightly with pepper and salt, then close and cut.
recipes.notes: Serve chilled or at room temperature. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, 2 tsp butter, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Tomato Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Arrange tomato slices on bread, add cheese and season with oregano and pepper. 2. (7 min) Cover with another slice and toast until the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Pat tomato slices dry to avoid soggy bread. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 1 medium chopped tomato, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp oregano, ¼ tsp black pepper

recipes.name: Potato Masala Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mash potatoes. 2. (5 min) Sauté cumin, onion and green chilli in a little oil; add turmeric, potato, coriander and salt. 3. (5 min) Cool slightly, fill bread slices and toast until crisp.
recipes.notes: A filling breakfast or snack. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp boiled potatoes, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Corn Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mix cooked corn with cheese, pepper and chilli flakes. 2. (7 min) Fill bread slices, butter the outside and grill until crisp and the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Frozen corn can be used after cooking and draining. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, ½ cup sweet corn, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp black pepper, ½ tsp chilli flakes

recipes.name: Paneer Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Crumble paneer and mix with finely chopped onion, capsicum, coriander, cumin, garam masala and salt. 2. (7 min) Fill bread and toast with butter until golden.
recipes.notes: Adjust spices to taste. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, ¼ tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — tandoori masala
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — tandoori masala

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Coat paneer, capsicum and onion in yogurt, ginger-garlic paste, tandoori masala, lemon and salt. 2. (5 min) Pan-roast until lightly charred. 3. (5 min) Place in bread and grill with butter.
recipes.notes: Marinate longer for deeper flavour. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled/grated paneer, ½ cup yogurt, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger-garlic paste, to taste / as needed — tandoori masala, ½ lemon juice, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Green Chutney Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Blend coriander, mint, chilli, lemon and salt into chutney. 2. (5 min) Butter bread, spread chutney and layer cucumber and potato. 3. (5 min) Close, trim if desired and serve or toast.
recipes.notes: Keep chutney thick so the bread stays firm. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ½ lemon juice, 2 tsp butter, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, 2 tsp boiled potato, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Bombay Masala Toast Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — green chutney
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — green chutney

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — sandwich masala
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — sandwich masala

recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mash potato with salt and a little chaat masala. 2. (7 min) Spread chutney on bread, add potato and sliced vegetables, sprinkle sandwich masala and toast with butter until crisp.
recipes.notes: Street-style layered masala toast. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp boiled potatoes, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, thinly sliced cucumber, to taste / as needed — green chutney, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp chaat masala, to taste / as needed — sandwich masala, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Mushroom Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Sauté chopped mushrooms, onion and garlic until their moisture evaporates. 2. (5 min) Season with pepper and salt. 3. (5 min) Fill bread with the mixture and cheese, then grill until golden.
recipes.notes: Cook mushrooms thoroughly before filling. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, to taste / as needed — mushrooms, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 2 tsp butter, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Spinach Corn Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Sauté garlic and chopped spinach until wilted. 2. (5 min) Add cooked corn and a splash of milk; cook until the filling thickens. 3. (5 min) Season, add cheese, fill bread and grill.
recipes.notes: Drain spinach well to keep the filling thick. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tbsp chopped spinach, ½ cup sweet corn, 1 cup milk, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 2 tsp butter, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Capsicum Onion Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Thinly slice capsicum and onion. 2. (5 min) Sauté briefly with butter, pepper and salt. 3. (5 min) Add to bread with cheese and toast until crisp.
recipes.notes: Keep vegetables slightly crunchy. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 2 tsp butter, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Coleslaw Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Finely shred cabbage and carrot. 2. (5 min) Mix with mayonnaise, a little lemon juice, pepper and salt. 3. (5 min) Spread between bread slices and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Use egg-free mayonnaise for a fully vegetarian version. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, to taste / as needed — cabbage, 1 small chopped carrot, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, ¼ tsp black pepper, ½ lemon juice, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Spread peanut butter on bread, layer banana slices and add a little honey and cinnamon if desired. 2. (2 min) Close and toast in a lightly buttered pan until golden.
recipes.notes: A quick sweet breakfast; honey is optional. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp peanut butter, to taste / as needed — banana, 1–2 tsp honey, ¼ tsp cinnamon powder, 2 tsp butter

recipes.name: Jam Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — fruit jam
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — fruit jam

recipes.preparation: 1. (2 min) Spread butter on one slice and jam on the other. 2. (2 min) Join the slices, trim the edges if desired and serve.
recipes.notes: Use any fruit jam. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, to taste / as needed — fruit jam, 2 tsp butter

recipes.name: Peanut Chutney Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Grind peanuts with coriander, chilli, garlic, lemon juice, salt and a little water into a thick spread. 2. (7 min) Apply to bread and toast lightly with butter.
recipes.notes: Add water gradually to keep the chutney spreadable. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tbsp roasted peanuts, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ½ lemon juice, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated garlic, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Egg Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Chop boiled eggs and mix with mayonnaise, mustard, pepper and salt. 2. (7 min) Spoon onto bread, add lettuce if available, close and serve.
recipes.notes: Keep refrigerated if not serving immediately. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp boiled eggs, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, to taste / as needed — mustard, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt, to taste / as needed — lettuce

recipes.name: Masala Egg Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Beat eggs with chopped onion, chilli, coriander, turmeric, cumin and salt. 2. (5 min) Scramble in a lightly buttered pan. 3. (5 min) Fill bread slices and toast until crisp.
recipes.notes: Cook eggs fully before assembling. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin powder, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Omelette Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Beat eggs with finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, pepper and salt. 2. (7 min) Cook into an omelette, place between bread slices and toast with butter.
recipes.notes: Fold the omelette to fit the bread. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Egg and Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Scramble or fry the eggs with pepper and salt. 2. (7 min) Place on bread with cheese, close the sandwich and toast until the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: A simple protein-rich breakfast. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 eggs, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese slice, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Egg Bhurji Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — pav bhaji masala
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — pav bhaji masala

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté onion, chilli and ginger in oil. 2. (4 min) Add tomato, turmeric, pav bhaji masala and salt. 3. (4 min) Add beaten eggs and stir until fully cooked. 4. (4 min) Fill bread and toast.
recipes.notes: Use leftover egg bhurji as filling. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 eggs, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 1 tsp finely chopped/grated ginger, ¼ tsp turmeric, to taste / as needed — pav bhaji masala, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, 2 tsp oil, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Mayonnaise Vegetable Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Finely chop or grate the vegetables. 2. (5 min) Mix with mayonnaise, pepper, salt and a few drops of lemon juice. 3. (5 min) Spread between bread slices and serve chilled.
recipes.notes: Choose egg-free mayonnaise if required. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 1 small chopped carrot, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, to taste / as needed — cabbage, 1 tbsp mayonnaise, ¼ tsp black pepper, ¼ tsp salt, ½ lemon juice

recipes.name: Aloo Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Mash potatoes with cumin, chilli, coriander and salt. 2. (7 min) Spread on bread, add grated cheese, close and toast with butter until golden.
recipes.notes: Add chopped onion for extra crunch. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tsp boiled potatoes, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, ¼ tsp cumin powder, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Chilli Cheese Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Mix cheese with finely chopped chilli, capsicum, onion and oregano. 2. (7 min) Spread on bread, cover with another slice and grill until the filling is hot and melted.
recipes.notes: Adjust green chilli to taste. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ¼ tsp oregano, 2 tsp butter

recipes.name: Schezwan Vegetable Sandwich

ingredients.item: to taste / as needed — Schezwan chutney
ingredients.original: to taste / as needed — Schezwan chutney

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté finely shredded vegetables briefly until just tender. 2. (5 min) Mix in Schezwan chutney and salt. 3. (5 min) Fill bread, butter the outside and grill until crisp.
recipes.notes: Use chutney sparingly if it is very spicy. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, to taste / as needed — cabbage, 1 small chopped carrot, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 1 medium finely chopped onion, to taste / as needed — Schezwan chutney, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Pesto Vegetable Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Spread pesto on bread. 2. (7 min) Layer tomato, capsicum and mozzarella, season with pepper, close and grill with a little olive oil until the cheese melts.
recipes.notes: Check pesto ingredients if avoiding animal rennet. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 2 tbsp chopped basil pesto, 1 medium chopped tomato, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, 100 g crumbled/grated mozzarella cheese, 2 tsp olive oil, ¼ tsp black pepper

recipes.name: Open-Faced Cheese Toast
recipes.preparation: 1. (7 min) Top each bread slice with chopped tomato, onion, capsicum, cheese, oregano and pepper. 2. (7 min) Toast in a covered pan or oven until the cheese melts and the bread crisps.
recipes.notes: Serve immediately while crisp. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled/grated cheese, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 medium finely chopped onion, ½ medium, chopped capsicum, ¼ tsp oregano, ¼ tsp black pepper

recipes.name: Paneer Bhurji Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Measure and prepare the ingredients. Sauté cumin, onion and chilli in a little butter. 2. (5 min) Add tomato, turmeric and salt, then paneer and coriander. 3. (5 min) Cook briefly, fill bread and toast until golden.
recipes.notes: Good use for leftover paneer bhurji. Quantities are approximate for 2 servings; adjust salt, spice and water to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 bread slices, 100 g crumbled paneer, 1 medium finely chopped onion, 1 medium chopped tomato, 1 small finely chopped green chilli, ¼ tsp turmeric, ¼ tsp cumin, 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves, 2 tsp butter, ¼ tsp salt

recipes.name: Piyaji (Bengali Onion Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Toss sliced onions with salt and leave for 5 minutes so they release moisture. 2. (3 min) Mix in chillies, nigella seeds, turmeric, chilli powder, coriander, besan and rice flour; add only a few drops of water if needed to bind. 3. (8 min) Drop small loose portions into medium-hot oil and fry, turning, until crisp and deep golden. Drain and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Bengali piyaji; the onion mixture should be moist and cling together without a runny batter. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 medium onions thinly sliced, ½ cup besan, 2 tbsp rice flour, 2 green chillies chopped, ½ tsp nigella seeds (kalonji), ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, salt, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, oil for frying

recipes.name: Beguni (Bengali Eggplant Fritters)

ingredients.item: medium eggplant/brinjal cut into ½ cm slices
ingredients.original: 1 medium eggplant/brinjal cut into ½ cm slices

recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Salt the eggplant slices lightly and pat dry. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour, turmeric, chilli powder, nigella seeds and salt; whisk in water to make a thick coating batter. 3. (8 min) Dip slices in batter and fry in medium-hot oil, turning once, until crisp outside and tender inside. Drain well.
recipes.notes: Classic Bengali monsoon snack, often served with muri or khichuri. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium eggplant/brinjal cut into ½ cm slices, ½ cup besan, 2 tbsp rice flour, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, pinch of nigella seeds, salt, water as needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Aloo Chop (Bengali Potato Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Mix mashed potatoes with onion, chilli, cumin, turmeric, garam masala, coriander and salt; shape into small flattened patties. 2. (3 min) Make a thick besan batter with water and a little salt. 3. (8 min) Coat patties in batter and fry over medium heat until crisp and golden on both sides. Drain before serving.
recipes.notes: Bengali-style aloo chop; adjust chilli to taste. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 medium potatoes boiled and mashed, 1 small onion finely chopped, 1 green chilli, ½ tsp roasted cumin powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, ½ cup besan, water as needed, salt, oil for frying

recipes.name: Phuluri (Bengali Besan Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Combine besan, rice flour, chilli, nigella seeds, turmeric and salt. 2. (2 min) Add water gradually to make a thick, spoonable batter; mix in baking soda if using. 3. (7 min) Drop small spoonfuls into medium-hot oil and fry, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain and serve with chutney.
recipes.notes: Simple Bengali batter fritters; keep the batter thick enough to hold its shape. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: ¾ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, 1 green chilli finely chopped, ½ tsp nigella seeds, ¼ tsp turmeric, pinch of baking soda (optional), salt, water, oil for frying

recipes.name: Kumro Phul Bhaja (Pumpkin Flower Fritters)

ingredients.item: oil for shallow or deep frying
ingredients.original: oil for shallow or deep frying

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Gently rinse pumpkin flowers, remove tough stems and pat completely dry. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour, turmeric, nigella seeds and salt with enough water for a light coating batter. 3. (6 min) Dip flowers, let excess batter drip off and fry carefully in medium-hot oil until crisp. Drain and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Seasonal Bengali delicacy; use edible pumpkin flowers from a safe food source. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 8–10 fresh pumpkin flowers, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp nigella seeds, salt, water as needed, oil for shallow or deep frying

recipes.name: Mochar Chop (Bengali Banana Blossom Croquettes)
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Cook the cleaned banana blossom until tender, drain very well and chop finely. 2. (5 min) Mix with potato, peanuts, ginger, cumin, garam masala, coriander and salt; shape into small croquettes. 3. (3 min) Roll in breadcrumbs. 4. (8 min) Shallow- or deep-fry over medium heat until evenly crisp and golden.
recipes.notes: Cleaning banana blossom takes additional time and care; these times assume it is already cleaned and cooked. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup cleaned banana blossom (mocha), finely chopped and cooked, 1 medium potato boiled and mashed, 1 tbsp roasted peanuts crushed, ½ tsp ginger paste, ½ tsp roasted cumin powder, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, ½ cup breadcrumbs, salt, oil for frying

recipes.name: Aloo Pyaz Pakora (Potato and Onion Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Toss potato and onion with salt, ajwain, chilli powder and turmeric. 2. (3 min) Add besan and rice flour; sprinkle in just enough water to coat the vegetables. 3. (8 min) Drop small portions into medium-hot oil and fry until crisp and cooked through, turning as needed. Drain well.
recipes.notes: Keep slices thin so potato cooks through before the coating darkens. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium potato thinly sliced, 1 medium onion sliced, ¾ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ½ tsp ajwain, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, salt, water as needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Palak Pakora (Spinach Fritters)

ingredients.item: spinach leaves washed and thoroughly dried
ingredients.original: 2 cups spinach leaves washed and thoroughly dried

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Roughly chop large spinach leaves and dry them well. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour, chilli, ajwain, chilli powder, turmeric and salt; add spinach and a little water to form a clingy mixture. 3. (6 min) Fry small clusters in medium-hot oil until crisp. Drain and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Dry leaves help prevent splattering and keep the fritters crisp. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups spinach leaves washed and thoroughly dried, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, 1 green chilli chopped, ½ tsp ajwain, ½ tsp chilli powder, pinch of turmeric, salt, water as needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Gobi Pakora (Cauliflower Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Cut cauliflower into small florets; blanch for 2 minutes if the pieces are thick, then drain and dry. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour and spices with enough water for a thick coating batter; coat florets. 3. (7 min) Fry over medium heat until golden and tender. Drain thoroughly.
recipes.notes: Small, dry florets cook more evenly. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups small cauliflower florets, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, ½ tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp ajwain, salt, water, oil for frying

recipes.name: Mirchi Bajji (Stuffed Green Chilli Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Slit chillies lengthwise and remove seeds if desired; dab with a little tamarind pulp for tang if liked. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour, ajwain, turmeric and salt with water into a thick batter. 3. (8 min) Dip chillies and fry over medium heat, turning carefully, until the coating is crisp and cooked. Drain before serving.
recipes.notes: Choose large mild bajji chillies; heat varies considerably by variety. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 6 large mild bajji chillies, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ½ tsp ajwain, ¼ tsp turmeric, salt, tamarind pulp (optional), water, oil for frying

recipes.name: Punugulu (Andhra Rice Batter Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Stir rice flour, onion, chilli, coriander and cumin into the batter; it should be thick enough to scoop. 2. (7 min) Drop small portions into medium-hot oil. Fry, turning occasionally, until golden and crisp outside and cooked through inside. Drain and serve with coconut chutney.
recipes.notes: A useful way to use thick leftover idli or dosa batter; add rice flour gradually. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup leftover idli/dosa batter, 2 tbsp rice flour, 1 small onion finely chopped, 1 green chilli chopped, 1 tbsp chopped coriander, ½ tsp cumin seeds, salt if needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Medu Vada (South Indian Urad Dal Fritters)
recipes.region: Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, South India

ingredients.item: urad dal soaked 3–4 hours and drained
ingredients.original: 1 cup urad dal soaked 3–4 hours and drained

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Grind drained urad dal to a thick, fluffy batter using as little water as possible. 2. (3 min) Mix in chilli, ginger, curry leaves, pepper, salt and optional onion. 3. (10 min) With wet hands, shape into rings and carefully slide into medium-hot oil. Fry both sides until golden and cooked through; drain.
recipes.notes: Soaking time is not included in prep_minutes. A thick batter is essential for shaping. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup urad dal soaked 3–4 hours and drained, 1 green chilli, 1 tsp chopped ginger, 1 tbsp chopped curry leaves, 1 tbsp chopped onion (optional), ½ tsp crushed pepper, salt, oil for frying

recipes.name: Mysore Bonda (South Indian Pepper Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Mix flour, yogurt, chilli, ginger, coconut, curry leaves, cumin, baking soda and salt. Add a little water to make a thick dropping batter. 2. (5 min) Rest briefly while heating oil. 3. (7 min) Drop small portions into medium-hot oil and fry, turning, until puffed and golden. Drain and serve with chutney.
recipes.notes: Use thick yogurt and add water sparingly so the bonda hold their shape. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup maida, ¼ cup thick yogurt, 1 green chilli chopped, 1 tsp chopped ginger, 1 tbsp chopped coconut, 1 tbsp chopped curry leaves, ½ tsp cumin, pinch of baking soda, salt, water as needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Kanda Bhaji (Maharashtrian Onion Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Toss onions with salt and leave briefly to soften. 2. (3 min) Add coriander seeds, chilli powder, turmeric, coriander, besan and rice flour; mix, adding only a little water if needed. 3. (8 min) Fry small loose clusters in medium-hot oil until crisp and golden, turning as needed. Drain well.
recipes.notes: Maharashtrian kanda bhaji should be craggy and crisp rather than formed into smooth balls. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 medium onions thinly sliced, ¾ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, 1 tsp crushed coriander seeds, ½ tsp chilli powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, salt, a little water if needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Methi Pakora (Fenugreek Leaf Fritters)
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Wash methi leaves and dry well; chop and combine with onion and chilli. 2. (3 min) Add besan, rice flour, ajwain, turmeric and salt with just enough water to bind. 3. (7 min) Fry small portions in medium-hot oil until crisp and cooked through. Drain and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Methi has a pleasantly bitter flavour; a little onion balances it. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup chopped fresh methi leaves, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, 1 small onion sliced, 1 green chilli chopped, ½ tsp ajwain, ¼ tsp turmeric, salt, water as needed, oil for frying

recipes.name: Paneer Pakora (Indian Cottage Cheese Fritters)

ingredients.original: 200 g paneer cut into thick cubes

recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Pat paneer dry and season lightly with salt and chilli powder. 2. (3 min) Whisk besan, rice flour, ajwain, turmeric, chilli powder and salt with water into a thick batter. 3. (6 min) Dip paneer cubes and fry in medium-hot oil until the coating is crisp and golden. Drain and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Avoid frying too long or paneer may become firm. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g paneer cut into thick cubes, ¾ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ½ tsp ajwain, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, salt, water, oil for frying

recipes.name: Raw Banana Bajji (Vazhakkai Fritters)
recipes.region: Tamil Nadu and Kerala, South India

ingredients.item: peeled and cut into thin lengthwise slices
ingredients.original: peeled and cut into thin lengthwise slices

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Peel raw banana and slice thinly; keep slices in water until ready to batter. 2. (3 min) Mix besan, rice flour, turmeric, chilli powder, asafoetida and salt with water into a coating batter. 3. (7 min) Dry banana slices, dip in batter and fry over medium heat until golden and cooked through. Drain well.
recipes.notes: Slice evenly so each piece cooks at the same rate. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 raw green banana, peeled and cut into thin lengthwise slices, ½ cup besan, 1 tbsp rice flour, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, pinch of asafoetida, salt, water, oil for frying

recipes.name: Vegetable Chow Mein (Veg Chowmein)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Boil noodles according to packet directions until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil. 2. (5 min) Heat oil in a wok; stir-fry garlic and onion, then add carrot, cabbage and capsicum. Keep vegetables slightly crisp. 3. (3 min) Add noodles, soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt. Toss over high heat and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Indo-Chinese street-style vegetable chow mein. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g noodles, 1 cup shredded cabbage, ½ cup julienned carrot, ½ cup sliced capsicum, ½ cup sliced onion, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp chilli sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp oil, salt and black pepper

recipes.name: Egg Chow Mein (Egg Chowmein)
recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Boil noodles until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil. 2. (3 min) Heat half the oil in a wok, scramble the beaten eggs until just set, then remove. 3. (5 min) Add remaining oil, garlic and onion; stir-fry carrot, cabbage and capsicum. 4. (3 min) Add noodles, scrambled egg, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt. Toss over high heat and serve.
recipes.notes: Egg-based Indo-Chinese chow mein. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g noodles, 2 eggs, ½ cup shredded cabbage, ½ cup julienned carrot, ½ cup sliced capsicum, ½ cup sliced onion, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp oil, salt and black pepper

recipes.name: Vegetable Masala Maggi Noodles
recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Heat oil in a pan and sauté onion, tomato and vegetables for 2–3 minutes. 2. (1 min) Add water and the tastemaker; bring to a boil. 3. (3 min) Break noodles into the pan and cook, stirring, until tender and the sauce reaches your preferred consistency. Garnish with coriander and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Quick Indian-style vegetable Maggi; adjust water for soupy or dry noodles. Check packet ingredients for allergens.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 packets instant noodles with tastemaker, ½ cup chopped onion, ½ cup chopped tomato, ½ cup diced carrot, ½ cup peas or capsicum, 1 tsp oil, 1½–2 cups water, ¼ tsp chilli powder (optional), chopped coriander

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Beat eggs with a pinch of salt. Heat half the oil in a wok and scramble until just set; remove. 2. (5 min) Add remaining oil and garlic, then stir-fry carrot and beans until crisp-tender. 3. (3 min) Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar and pepper; toss over high heat. Return the egg, add spring onion and stir until piping hot.
recipes.notes: Simple Indo-Chinese egg fried rice. Use properly chilled leftover rice and reheat thoroughly.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 cups cooked, cooled rice, 2 eggs, ½ cup diced carrot, ½ cup chopped beans, ½ cup sliced spring onion, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1½ tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp oil, salt and black pepper

recipes.name: Chilli Paneer (Dry)

ingredients.original: 1 tbsp oil plus extra for pan-frying

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Lightly coat paneer with cornflour and a little water. Pan-fry in a little oil until lightly golden; set aside. 2. (4 min) In a hot pan, stir-fry garlic, ginger, onion and capsicum while keeping them crisp. 3. (2 min) Mix soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup, vinegar and water; add to the pan. Toss in paneer until coated and glossy. Garnish with spring onion.
recipes.notes: Indo-Chinese dry chilli paneer; check sauces for allergens and adjust chilli to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g paneer cubes, 2 tbsp cornflour, 1 tbsp oil plus extra for pan-frying, 1 sliced onion, 1 sliced capsicum, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1 tsp minced ginger, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp chilli sauce, 1 tbsp tomato ketchup, 1 tsp vinegar, 2 tbsp water, spring onion

recipes.name: Vegetable Manchurian (Dry)

ingredients.item: oil for cooking; sauce: 1 tbsp oil
ingredients.original: oil for cooking; sauce: 1 tbsp oil
1 tsp cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp water

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Squeeze excess moisture from cabbage and carrot. Mix with spring onion, ginger-garlic, flours, salt and pepper; shape into small balls. 2. (8 min) Shallow-fry or air-fry the balls until cooked and golden. 3. (4 min) For the sauce, stir-fry garlic in oil, add soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup and water. Stir in cornflour slurry until glossy, then toss the balls in the sauce and serve immediately.
recipes.notes: Dry-style vegetable Manchurian. The mixture should hold together; add flour sparingly if needed.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups finely shredded cabbage, ½ cup grated carrot, 2 tbsp chopped spring onion, 3 tbsp cornflour, 2 tbsp plain flour, 1 tsp minced ginger-garlic, salt and pepper, oil for cooking; sauce: 1 tbsp oil, 1 tsp minced garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp chilli sauce, 1 tbsp tomato ketchup, ¼ cup water, 1 tsp cornflour mixed with 1 tbsp water

recipes.name: Hot Garlic Noodles

ingredients.original: 1–2 tsp chilli flakes or chilli sauce

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Boil noodles until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil. 2. (4 min) Heat oil in a wok and fry garlic with chilli briefly without burning. Add carrot, cabbage and capsicum; stir-fry over high heat. 3. (3 min) Add noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt. Toss thoroughly and serve hot.
recipes.notes: Spicy garlic noodles; add sliced green chilli if desired. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g noodles, 1 cup shredded cabbage, ½ cup sliced capsicum, ½ cup julienned carrot, 1 tbsp minced garlic, 1–2 tsp chilli flakes or chilli sauce, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper

recipes.name: Bengali Chingri Malaikari

ingredients.item: finely ground; 1 tsp ginger paste; 1 tsp garlic paste; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green cardamoms; 1 small cinnamon stick; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; salt; 2 green chillies
ingredients.original: finely ground; 1 tsp ginger paste; 1 tsp garlic paste; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green cardamoms; 1 small cinnamon stick; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; salt; 2 green chillies

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Toss prawns with a little salt and turmeric. 2. (4 min) Lightly sear prawns in hot mustard oil and remove. 3. (6 min) Fry whole spices and onion paste; add ginger, garlic, cumin, chilli and turmeric with a splash of water. 4. (5 min) Stir in coconut milk and simmer gently. 5. (3 min) Return prawns and green chillies; cook just until prawns are opaque. Avoid boiling the coconut milk hard.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. Serve with steamed rice; cook prawns only until just done.
recipes.ingredients_original: 300 g prawns, cleaned; 1 cup coconut milk; 1 onion, finely ground; 1 tsp ginger paste; 1 tsp garlic paste; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green cardamoms; 1 small cinnamon stick; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; salt; 2 green chillies

recipes.name: Lau Chingri (Bottle Gourd with Prawns)

ingredients.item: optional and thinly sliced; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 green chillies; 2 tbsp mustard oil; salt; ½ tsp sugar
ingredients.original: optional and thinly sliced; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 green chillies; 2 tbsp mustard oil; salt; ½ tsp sugar

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Toss prawns with salt and turmeric; briefly fry in mustard oil and set aside. 2. (3 min) Temper cumin seeds and green chillies. 3. (8 min) Add potato if using and cook briefly, then add bottle gourd, ginger, cumin powder and salt. 4. (10 min) Cover and cook until the gourd releases water and becomes tender, stirring occasionally. 5. (3 min) Add prawns and optional sugar; cook until prawns are done and excess liquid reduces.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. A Bengali vegetable-and-prawn dish; adjust water depending on how juicy the gourd is.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g small prawns, cleaned; 500 g bottle gourd, cut into thin strips; 1 potato, optional and thinly sliced; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 green chillies; 2 tbsp mustard oil; salt; ½ tsp sugar, optional

recipes.name: Aloo Chingri Jhol (Potato and Prawn Curry)

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green chillies; salt; 2 cups water
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green chillies; salt; 2 cups water

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Season prawns with salt and turmeric; quickly sear in mustard oil and remove. 2. (5 min) Fry potato cubes until lightly golden. 3. (4 min) Add cumin seeds, ginger, tomato, cumin powder and chilli powder; cook until softened. 4. (12 min) Add water, cover and simmer until potatoes are nearly tender. 5. (3 min) Add prawns and green chillies; simmer gently until prawns are cooked through.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. Keep the gravy light and serve with rice.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g prawns, cleaned; 2 potatoes, cubed; 1 tomato, chopped; 1 tsp ginger paste; ½ tsp cumin seeds; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp mustard oil; 2 green chillies; salt; 2 cups water

recipes.name: Prawn and Mixed Vegetable Curry

ingredients.item: sliced; ½ cup green peas; 1 potato
ingredients.original: sliced; ½ cup green peas; 1 potato

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1½ cups water
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1½ cups water

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Season prawns with salt and turmeric, quickly sear in oil and set aside. 2. (5 min) Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant. 3. (4 min) Add tomato, coriander and cumin powders; cook until soft. 4. (12 min) Add potato, carrot, cauliflower, peas and water; cover and cook until vegetables are tender. 5. (4 min) Add prawns and simmer until opaque and cooked through.
recipes.notes: For 3 servings. Use seasonal vegetables and avoid overcooking the prawns.
recipes.ingredients_original: 300 g prawns, cleaned; 1 cup cauliflower florets; 1 carrot, sliced; ½ cup green peas; 1 potato, cubed; 1 onion, chopped; 1 tomato, chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1½ cups water

recipes.name: Prawn Egg Curry

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Hard-boil eggs, peel and lightly score them. 2. (3 min) Season prawns with a pinch of salt and turmeric; quickly sear in oil and remove. 3. (6 min) Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste; add tomato and powdered spices and cook until thick. 4. (8 min) Add water and eggs; simmer so the flavours combine. 5. (3 min) Add prawns and cook until opaque. Finish with coriander leaves.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. Contains both egg and shellfish; serve with rice.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g prawns, cleaned; 3 eggs, hard-boiled; 1 onion, finely chopped; 1 tomato, chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp chilli powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves

recipes.name: Prawn Omelette

ingredients.item: cleaned and chopped; 3 eggs; 1 small onion
ingredients.original: cleaned and chopped; 3 eggs; 1 small onion

ingredients.item: chopped; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; ¼ tsp turmeric; salt and pepper; 1 tbsp oil
ingredients.original: chopped; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; ¼ tsp turmeric; salt and pepper; 1 tbsp oil

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) If prawns are raw, sauté them in a little oil until just cooked and set aside. 2. (2 min) Beat eggs with onion, chilli, coriander, turmeric, salt and pepper. 3. (1 min) Fold in cooked prawns. 4. (5 min) Pour into a lightly oiled pan and cook over medium-low heat; flip carefully or cover until the centre is set.
recipes.notes: For 1–2 servings. Ensure the egg is fully set and the prawns are cooked through.
recipes.ingredients_original: 150 g small prawns, cleaned and chopped; 3 eggs; 1 small onion, finely chopped; 1 green chilli, chopped; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; ¼ tsp turmeric; salt and pepper; 1 tbsp oil

recipes.name: Prawn and Egg Fried Rice

ingredients.item: cleaned; 2 eggs; ½ cup diced carrot; ½ cup peas; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves
ingredients.original: cleaned; 2 eggs; ½ cup diced carrot; ½ cup peas; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves

ingredients.item: minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed
ingredients.original: minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Pat prawns dry and season lightly. 2. (3 min) Heat a wok, scramble eggs in a little oil and set aside. 3. (3 min) Stir-fry prawns until opaque and cooked; remove. 4. (4 min) Add remaining oil, garlic, carrot and peas; stir-fry until just tender. 5. (4 min) Add chilled rice, soy sauce, vinegar and pepper; toss over high heat. 6. (2 min) Return prawns and eggs, add spring onions and toss well.
recipes.notes: For 2 servings. Use rice cooled promptly after cooking; contains shellfish, egg and soy.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups cooked, chilled rice; 200 g prawns, cleaned; 2 eggs; ½ cup diced carrot; ½ cup peas; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves, minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.name: Prawn Chow Mein

ingredients.item: cleaned; 200 g noodles; 1 cup shredded cabbage; 1 carrot
ingredients.original: cleaned; 200 g noodles; 1 cup shredded cabbage; 1 carrot

ingredients.item: minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tsp chilli sauce
ingredients.original: minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tsp chilli sauce

recipes.preparation: 1. (6 min) Boil noodles until just tender, drain and toss with a little oil. 2. (3 min) Stir-fry prawns in a hot wok until opaque; remove. 3. (4 min) Add oil and garlic, then stir-fry cabbage, carrot and capsicum over high heat. 4. (3 min) Add noodles, soy sauce, vinegar, optional chilli sauce and pepper; toss thoroughly. 5. (2 min) Return prawns, add spring onions and stir-fry until hot.
recipes.notes: For 2 servings. Check noodle ingredients if avoiding egg; contains shellfish, soy and often wheat.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g prawns, cleaned; 200 g noodles; 1 cup shredded cabbage; 1 carrot, julienned; 1 capsicum, sliced; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves, minced; 1½ tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tsp chilli sauce, optional; 2 tbsp oil; pepper

recipes.name: Prawn Vegetable Fried Rice

ingredients.item: diced; ½ cup peas; ½ cup capsicum
ingredients.original: diced; ½ cup peas; ½ cup capsicum

ingredients.item: diced; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves; 1 tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed
ingredients.original: diced; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves; 1 tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Pat prawns dry and season lightly. 2. (4 min) Stir-fry prawns in a hot wok until opaque and cooked; set aside. 3. (4 min) Add oil and garlic, then carrot, peas and capsicum; stir-fry until crisp-tender. 4. (4 min) Add chilled rice, soy sauce, vinegar and pepper; toss over high heat. 5. (2 min) Return prawns, add spring onions and toss until evenly mixed and hot.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. Add scrambled egg if desired; contains shellfish and soy.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups cooked, chilled rice; 250 g prawns, cleaned; ½ cup carrot, diced; ½ cup peas; ½ cup capsicum, diced; 2 spring onions; 2 garlic cloves; 1 tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 2 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.name: Prawn Pakora (Prawn Fritters)

ingredients.item: cleaned and patted dry; ½ cup besan (gram flour); 2 tbsp rice flour; 1 small onion
ingredients.original: cleaned and patted dry; ½ cup besan (gram flour); 2 tbsp rice flour; 1 small onion

ingredients.item: chopped; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp chilli powder; ½ tsp ajwain
ingredients.original: chopped; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp chilli powder; ½ tsp ajwain

ingredients.item: optional; 1 tbsp chopped coriander; salt; 3–5 tbsp water as needed; oil for frying
ingredients.original: optional; 1 tbsp chopped coriander; salt; 3–5 tbsp water as needed; oil for frying

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Chop prawns into bite-sized pieces if large. Mix with onion, chilli, coriander, turmeric, chilli powder, ajwain and salt. 2. (3 min) Add besan and rice flour; sprinkle in just enough water to make a thick coating that clings. 3. (5 min) Heat oil over medium heat. Drop small portions carefully into the oil. 4. (5–7 min) Fry in batches, turning, until crisp and prawns are cooked through. Drain on a rack or paper towel.
recipes.notes: Prawn fritter recipe. For about 10–12 small pakoras. Keep oil hot but not smoking; do not crowd the pan. Contains shellfish.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g medium prawns, cleaned and patted dry; ½ cup besan (gram flour); 2 tbsp rice flour; 1 small onion, thinly sliced; 1 green chilli, chopped; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp chilli powder; ½ tsp ajwain, optional; 1 tbsp chopped coriander; salt; 3–5 tbsp water as needed; oil for frying

recipes.name: Prawn Chop (Bengali Prawn Cutlet)

ingredients.item: cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato
ingredients.original: cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp roasted cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 green chilli
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp roasted cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 green chilli

ingredients.item: chopped; salt; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; 2 tbsp flour; 1 egg
ingredients.original: chopped; salt; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; 2 tbsp flour; 1 egg

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Cook chopped prawns in a pan with a little oil until just done. 2. (5 min) Sauté onion, ginger-garlic, chilli and spices; mix with prawns, mashed potato and coriander. Cool until easy to handle. 3. (5 min) Shape into oval chops. Coat lightly with flour, dip in beaten egg and roll in breadcrumbs. 4. (6–8 min) Shallow-fry over medium heat, turning until golden and hot throughout. Drain before serving.
recipes.notes: For 6 small chops. Contains shellfish, egg and gluten; chill the mixture briefly if too soft to shape.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g prawns, cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato, boiled and mashed; 1 small onion, chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp roasted cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 green chilli, chopped; salt; 2 tbsp coriander leaves; 2 tbsp flour; 1 egg, beaten; breadcrumbs; oil for shallow-frying

recipes.name: Prawn and Potato Fritters

ingredients.item: cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato
ingredients.original: cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato

ingredients.item: grated and squeezed dry; ½ small onion
ingredients.original: grated and squeezed dry; ½ small onion

ingredients.item: finely chopped; ¼ cup besan; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; salt; coriander leaves; oil for frying
ingredients.original: finely chopped; ¼ cup besan; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; salt; coriander leaves; oil for frying

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Combine chopped prawns, squeezed potato, onion, besan, chilli, spices, salt and coriander. 2. (2 min) Mix until the batter holds together; add a teaspoon of water only if needed. 3. (5–7 min) Drop small spoonfuls into medium-hot oil and flatten slightly. 4. (6–8 min) Fry, turning occasionally, until golden and prawns are fully cooked. Drain and serve hot.
recipes.notes: For 8–10 fritters. Keep the grated potato dry for crisp edges. Contains shellfish.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g prawns, cleaned and finely chopped; 1 medium potato, grated and squeezed dry; ½ small onion, finely chopped; ¼ cup besan; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; salt; coriander leaves; oil for frying

recipes.name: Crispy Prawn Tempura-Style Fritters

ingredients.item: peeled and deveined; ½ cup plain flour; ¼ cup cornflour; ½ tsp baking powder; ½ cup ice-cold water
ingredients.original: peeled and deveined; ½ cup plain flour; ¼ cup cornflour; ½ tsp baking powder; ½ cup ice-cold water

ingredients.item: approximately; salt and pepper; oil for frying; lemon wedges
ingredients.original: approximately; salt and pepper; oil for frying; lemon wedges

recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Pat prawns very dry and season lightly with salt and pepper. 2. (2 min) Mix flour, cornflour and baking powder; whisk in ice-cold water just until combined, leaving the batter slightly lumpy. 3. (3 min) Heat oil to medium-high. Dip prawns in batter, letting excess drip off. 4. (4–6 min) Fry in small batches until pale golden, crisp and cooked through. Drain and serve immediately with lemon or a dipping sauce.
recipes.notes: For 2 servings. Keep batter cold and avoid overcrowding. Contains shellfish and gluten.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g large prawns, peeled and deveined; ½ cup plain flour; ¼ cup cornflour; ½ tsp baking powder; ½ cup ice-cold water, approximately; salt and pepper; oil for frying; lemon wedges

recipes.name: Prawn and Spring Onion Egg Fritters

ingredients.item: cleaned and finely chopped; 2 eggs; 2 spring onions
ingredients.original: cleaned and finely chopped; 2 eggs; 2 spring onions

ingredients.item: sliced; 2 tbsp flour; 1 tbsp cornflour; 1 small carrot
ingredients.original: sliced; 2 tbsp flour; 1 tbsp cornflour; 1 small carrot

ingredients.item: optional; pepper; salt; 1 tbsp oil plus more as needed
ingredients.original: optional; pepper; salt; 1 tbsp oil plus more as needed

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) If using raw prawns, finely chop and pat dry. 2. (2 min) Beat eggs; mix with prawns, spring onions, carrot, flour, cornflour, pepper and salt. 3. (2 min) Heat a thin layer of oil in a non-stick pan. Spoon small rounds of mixture into the pan. 4. (5–7 min) Cook over medium heat, turning once, until both sides are golden and the egg is set and prawns fully cooked.
recipes.notes: For 6 small fritters. Contains shellfish and egg; cook in small portions so the prawn mixture cooks through.
recipes.ingredients_original: 200 g prawns, cleaned and finely chopped; 2 eggs; 2 spring onions, sliced; 2 tbsp flour; 1 tbsp cornflour; 1 small carrot, grated; 1 green chilli, optional; pepper; salt; 1 tbsp oil plus more as needed

recipes.name: Prawn and Cabbage Stir-Fry

ingredients.item: minced; 1 tsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed
ingredients.original: minced; 1 tsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Pat prawns dry and season lightly. 2. (3–4 min) Stir-fry prawns in hot oil until opaque and cooked; remove. 3. (1 min) Add garlic, then cabbage, carrot and capsicum; stir-fry until crisp-tender. 4. (2 min) Add soy sauce, vinegar and pepper. 5. (1 min) Return prawns and toss until hot; serve immediately.
recipes.notes: For 2 servings. Works as a side dish or noodle filling. Contains shellfish and soy.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g prawns, cleaned; 2 cups shredded cabbage; 1 carrot, julienned; 1 capsicum, sliced; 2 garlic cloves, minced; 1 tsp soy sauce; 1 tsp vinegar; 1 tbsp oil; pepper; salt as needed

recipes.name: Prawn and Green Pea Curry

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves

recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Season prawns with salt and turmeric; briefly sear in oil and remove. 2. (5 min) Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste until fragrant. 3. (4 min) Add tomato and powdered spices; cook until soft. 4. (7 min) Add peas and water; cover and simmer until peas are tender. 5. (3 min) Add prawns and simmer gently until cooked through. Finish with coriander.
recipes.notes: For 2–3 servings. Fresh or frozen peas work well; serve with rice or roti.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g prawns, cleaned; 1 cup green peas; 1 onion, chopped; 1 tomato, chopped; 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste; ½ tsp turmeric; 1 tsp coriander powder; ½ tsp cumin powder; 2 tbsp oil; salt; 1 cup water; coriander leaves

recipes.name: Prawn Bhurji with Onion and Capsicum

ingredients.item: chopped; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 tbsp oil; salt; coriander leaves
ingredients.original: chopped; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 tbsp oil; salt; coriander leaves

recipes.preparation: 1. (4 min) Heat oil and sauté onion and chilli until softened. 2. (3 min) Add capsicum and cook until slightly tender. 3. (3 min) Add tomato, turmeric, cumin and salt; cook until saucy. 4. (4–5 min) Add chopped prawns and stir-fry until fully opaque and cooked. 5. (1 min) Sprinkle garam masala and coriander; serve hot with toast, roti or paratha.
recipes.notes: For 2 servings. Despite the name, this version contains no egg; add beaten egg at the end if desired and cook until set.
recipes.ingredients_original: 250 g prawns, cleaned and finely chopped; 1 onion, finely chopped; 1 capsicum, diced; 1 tomato, chopped; 1 green chilli; ½ tsp turmeric; ½ tsp cumin powder; ½ tsp garam masala; 1 tbsp oil; salt; coriander leaves

recipes.name: Rajasthani Gatte ki Sabzi

ingredients.item: chilli powder and salt; water as needed. For gravy: 1 small onion
ingredients.original: chilli powder and salt; water as needed. For gravy: 1 small onion
¼ tsp garam masala and 2 tbsp oil.

recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Mix besan, yogurt, oil, ajwain, spices and salt; add a little water to make a firm dough. Roll into logs. 2. (10 min) Boil the logs until cooked, reserve a little cooking water, cool and slice. 3. (10 min) Prepare a spiced onion-tomato gravy, lower the heat and whisk in yogurt gradually. 4. (5 min) Add gatte and a little reserved water; simmer until the gravy coats them.
recipes.notes: Traditional Rajasthani gram-flour dumplings in yogurt-spiced gravy; quantities are approximate for 2–3 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: For gatte: 1 cup besan, 1 tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp oil, ¼ tsp ajwain, ¼ tsp turmeric, chilli powder and salt; water as needed. For gravy: 1 small onion, 1 tomato, ½ cup yogurt, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin, ¼ tsp garam masala and 2 tbsp oil.

recipes.name: Pitor (Pitod) ki Sabzi
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Whisk besan with water, turmeric, chilli powder and salt until smooth. 2. (10 min) Cook over low-medium heat, stirring continuously, until very thick. Spread onto a greased plate, cool and cut into squares. 3. (8 min) Temper cumin and asafoetida in oil, add ginger and coriander powder. Lower heat and stir in whisked yogurt gradually. 4. (5 min) Add pitor pieces and a little water; simmer gently and garnish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Also called pitod or pitor curry; stir the besan mixture continuously to prevent lumps. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup besan, 1½ cups water, ½ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder, salt; 1 cup yogurt, 1 tsp ginger paste, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin, a pinch of asafoetida, 2 tbsp oil and fresh coriander.

recipes.name: Gatte Pulao
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Rinse and soak rice for 15 minutes, then drain. Prepare or use cooked besan gatte and slice them. 2. (5 min) Heat oil or ghee; add cumin and whole spices, then onion and ginger-garlic paste. 3. (3 min) Add gatte, turmeric, garam masala and rice; stir gently. 4. (15 min) Add water and salt, cover and cook on low until rice is tender. Rest for 5 minutes before fluffing.
recipes.notes: A Rajasthani rice dish using gram-flour dumplings; adjust water according to the rice variety.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup basmati rice, ½ cup cooked sliced gatte, 1 small onion, 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste, ½ tsp cumin, 1 bay leaf, 2 cloves, 1 small cinnamon piece, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp oil or ghee, salt and 1¾ cups water.

recipes.name: Methi Gatte ki Sabzi

ingredients.original: ¼ cup finely chopped fenugreek leaves
1 tsp ginger paste and 2 tbsp oil.

recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Mix besan, methi leaves, yogurt, oil, ajwain and salt into a firm dough; shape into logs. 2. (10 min) Boil logs until cooked, cool and slice. 3. (8 min) Make a cumin, ginger and spice tempering; lower heat and gradually stir in whisked yogurt. 4. (5 min) Add gatte with a little water and simmer until the curry comes together.
recipes.notes: Fenugreek adds a pleasantly bitter, aromatic flavour; quantities are approximate for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup besan, ¼ cup finely chopped fenugreek leaves, 1 tbsp yogurt, 1 tbsp oil, ¼ tsp ajwain, salt; ½ cup yogurt, 1 tsp coriander powder, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp turmeric, chilli powder, 1 tsp ginger paste and 2 tbsp oil.

recipes.name: Gujarati Khandvi
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Whisk besan, yogurt, water, turmeric and salt until completely smooth. 2. (10 min) Cook over low-medium heat, stirring constantly, until thick and spreadable. 3. (5 min) Quickly spread a very thin layer over clean steel plates or a heat-safe flat surface. Let set briefly, then cut into strips and roll. 4. (3 min) Temper mustard, sesame and asafoetida in oil; spoon over the rolls and garnish with coconut and coriander.
recipes.notes: Work quickly while spreading the cooked batter; test a small patch first to ensure it rolls cleanly. Approximate quantities for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: ½ cup besan, ½ cup sour yogurt, 1 cup water, ¼ tsp turmeric, salt; 1 tsp oil, ½ tsp mustard seeds, 1 tsp sesame seeds, a pinch of asafoetida, grated coconut and chopped coriander.

recipes.name: Besan Koki

ingredients.original: 2 tbsp oil and water as needed.

recipes.preparation: 1. (8 min) Mix wheat flour, besan, onion, chilli, coriander, spices, salt and oil. Add water gradually to make a firm dough. 2. (5 min) Divide and roll into thick discs. 3. (10 min) Cook each disc on a hot tawa over medium-low heat, pressing gently and applying a little oil on both sides, until crisp and cooked through.
recipes.notes: A hearty Sindhi flatbread; traditionally rolled thick and cooked slowly for a crisp outside and cooked centre.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup whole-wheat flour, ¼ cup besan, 1 small onion finely chopped, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp chopped coriander, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp crushed coriander seeds, salt, 2 tbsp oil and water as needed.

recipes.name: Papad ki Sabzi
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Break papads into medium pieces; roast or briefly fry them and set aside. 2. (5 min) Heat oil, add cumin and asafoetida, then ginger and chopped tomato with the spices. Cook until soft. 3. (3 min) Lower the heat and whisk in yogurt gradually. Add a little water to make a light gravy. 4. (2 min) Add papad pieces just before serving and simmer briefly so they soften without dissolving; garnish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Add papad near serving time to control the texture; quantities are approximate for 2 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 plain papads, ½ cup yogurt, 1 small tomato, 1 tsp ginger paste, ½ tsp cumin, ½ tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, chilli powder, a pinch of asafoetida, 1 tbsp oil and chopped coriander.

recipes.name: Dhokar Dalna with Peas
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Drain and grind soaked chana dal coarsely with ginger, cumin and salt. Cook the paste in a little oil, stirring until it thickens; spread on a greased plate, cool and cut into diamond-shaped cakes. 2. (10 min) Shallow-fry the cakes until golden. 3. (10 min) Fry potato, then cook tomato with bay leaf, turmeric and cumin powder. Add peas and water; simmer until potato is tender. 4. (5 min) Add the dhoka cakes and garam masala, simmer gently for a few minutes and serve.
recipes.notes: A variation on Bengali dhokar dalna with peas; handle the lentil cakes gently once they enter the gravy. Approximate quantities for 2–3 servings.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup chana dal, soaked 4 hours, ½ cup peas, 1 potato cubed, 1 tomato, 1 tsp ginger paste, ½ tsp cumin, 1 tsp cumin powder, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 bay leaf, ½ tsp garam masala, 2 tbsp oil and salt.

recipes.name: Aloo Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil, peel and mash the potatoes. 2. (5 min) Mix with onion, chilli, mustard oil, coriander, salt and a little lemon juice. Serve with rice or roti.
recipes.notes: Approximate quantities for 2 servings; adjust chilli and mustard oil to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 medium potatoes, 1 small onion finely chopped, 1 green chilli, 2 tbsp mustard oil, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, salt to taste, lemon juice to taste

recipes.name: Tomato Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (10 min) Roast tomatoes until the skins blister, then peel and mash. 2. (5 min) Mix with chopped onion, chilli, mustard oil, coriander and salt.
recipes.notes: Can also be made with tomatoes cooked in a hot pan.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 ripe tomatoes, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp mustard oil, 2 tbsp chopped coriander, salt to taste

recipes.name: Lauki Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Heat oil, crackle cumin and sauté onion and chilli. 2. (15 min) Add tomato, turmeric and grated lauki; cook until tender and most moisture evaporates. Mash lightly and finish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Cook uncovered at the end to remove excess moisture.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups grated bottle gourd, 1 small onion, 1 tomato, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp oil, ½ tsp cumin, turmeric, salt, coriander

recipes.name: Mooli Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Squeeze excess water from grated radish. 2. (12 min) Heat mustard oil, add cumin, onion and chilli; add radish and salt and cook until tender. Mash lightly and garnish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Serve with roti or paratha.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups grated radish, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp mustard oil, ½ tsp cumin, salt, chopped coriander

recipes.name: Pumpkin Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (12 min) Steam or boil pumpkin until soft and drain well. 2. (8 min) Sauté cumin, onion and chilli in oil; add pumpkin, turmeric and salt. Mash and cook until thick, then add coriander.
recipes.notes: A lightly sweet, mildly spiced side dish.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 cups peeled pumpkin cubes, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp oil, ½ tsp cumin, turmeric, salt, coriander

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil or roast sweet potatoes until soft, peel and mash. 2. (5 min) Mix with onion, chilli, mustard oil, salt, lemon juice and coriander.
recipes.notes: Adjust lemon juice to balance the natural sweetness.
recipes.ingredients_original: 2 medium sweet potatoes, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp mustard oil, salt, lemon juice, coriander

recipes.name: Garlic Potato Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil and mash potatoes. 2. (5 min) Crush garlic and chilli; mix with potatoes, chopped onion, mustard oil, salt and coriander. For a softer garlic flavour, briefly sauté the garlic first.
recipes.notes: Traditional-style mustard-oil mash; adjust raw garlic to taste.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 potatoes, 3 garlic cloves, 1 small onion, 1 tbsp mustard oil, 1 green chilli, salt, coriander

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetable Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil vegetables until soft and drain well. 2. (8 min) Sauté cumin, onion and chilli; add vegetables, salt and mash roughly. Cook briefly and finish with coriander.
recipes.notes: Use seasonal vegetables and avoid overcooking peas.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 cup potato, ½ cup carrot, ½ cup peas, ½ cup cauliflower, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp oil, cumin, salt, coriander

recipes.name: Karela Aloo Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil potatoes; slice bitter gourd thinly, salt lightly and rest 10 minutes, then rinse and squeeze. 2. (10 min) Pan-fry bitter gourd until tender and lightly browned. Mash potatoes and mix with bitter gourd, onion, chilli, mustard oil and salt.
recipes.notes: For less bitterness, remove seeds and squeeze the salted bitter gourd well.
recipes.ingredients_original: 1 medium bitter gourd, 2 potatoes, 1 small onion, 1 green chilli, 1 tbsp mustard oil, salt, turmeric

recipes.name: Kerala-Style Potato Bharta
recipes.preparation: 1. (15 min) Boil, peel and roughly mash potatoes. 2. (5 min) Heat coconut oil, splutter mustard seeds and sauté shallots, chilli and curry leaves. Stir in grated coconut, add potatoes and salt, mix well and finish with a little lime juice.
recipes.notes: Kerala-inspired potato mash with coconut oil, curry leaves and coconut.
recipes.ingredients_original: 3 potatoes, 1 small onion or 2 shallots, 1 green chilli, 6 curry leaves, 2 tbsp grated coconut, 1 tbsp coconut oil, ¼ tsp mustard seeds, salt, lime juice

recipes.name: Cucumber Tomato Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Spread butter or chutney over the bread. 2. (2 min) Layer cucumber and tomato, season lightly, close the sandwich and cut into halves.
recipes.notes: Pat tomato slices dry to prevent soggy bread; serves 2.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 slices bread, ½ cucumber thinly sliced, 1 tomato thinly sliced, 2 tbsp butter or green chutney, salt, black pepper

recipes.name: Tomato Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (3 min) Spread butter or mayonnaise on bread. 2. (2 min) Arrange tomato slices and optional lettuce; season with salt and pepper, close and serve.
recipes.notes: Use firm tomatoes and remove excess seeds if very juicy; serves 2.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 slices bread, 1 large firm tomato thinly sliced, 2 tbsp butter or mayonnaise, salt, black pepper, optional lettuce

recipes.name: Onion Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Separate onion slices and rinse briefly if you prefer a milder flavour; pat dry. 2. (2 min) Spread butter or chutney on bread, add onion and optional cucumber, season with chaat masala and pepper, then close and serve.
recipes.notes: Serves 2; add cheese or toast in a pan if desired.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 slices bread, 1 small onion thinly sliced, 2 tbsp butter or green chutney, ¼ tsp chaat masala, black pepper, salt, optional cucumber

recipes.name: Cucumber Tomato Onion Sandwich
recipes.preparation: 1. (5 min) Thinly slice cucumber, tomato and onion; pat the tomato dry. 2. (2 min) Spread chutney or butter on bread, layer vegetables, season lightly, close and cut to serve.
recipes.notes: Serves 2; works well as a fresh lunchbox sandwich.
recipes.ingredients_original: 4 slices bread, ½ cucumber, 1 tomato, ½ small onion, 2 tbsp green chutney or butter, salt, black pepper, chaat masala
